turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to pick a way to budget because I keep running out of money before payday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: First let me tell you about all of them, then you can comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One method is tracking every single purchase in a spreadsheet, which is detailed but takes time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another one is the envelope method, where I take out cash for each category every week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could use a budgeting app that connects to my bank and sorts everything automatically.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Do you mostly overspend on small things like coffee and snacks? If so, the envelope method could really help. Otherwise, I'd start with the app and check it once a week.
